notes.title: MADELA : Update
notes.content:
New scenes and more gameplay added, also now support more features and previous bugs fixed.

We looking for a good experience for who plays our game and we will try to publish a new version every few weeks or months.

in this update, we add more gameplay near a few minutes but we promise you after game exit from Early Acess will be at least 2 or 3 hours gameplay.
